name: GOV.UK
body: Accessibility 100, a strict content security policy, and real visitors see the main content in 0.7 s. The one gap: 19 of the 20 pages read have no canonical link.
lesson: Give every page a canonical link, even when only one address serves it. One line settles which URL ranks.
summary: www.gov.uk scores 92 out of 100 (A). 0 checks fail now, 11 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: 19 pages have no canonical link.

fix.title: 19 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /help/cookies, /browse, /browse/benefits, /browse/births-deaths-marriages and 15 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: 3 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /help/cookies, /browse, /government/organisations. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: No llms.txt was found
fix.evidence: /llms.txt returned 404. It is a proposed convention that some AI tools read to find the pages that matter.
fix.fix: Publish /llms.txt. The fix kit has a draft built from this read.

fix.title: No CAA record limits who may issue certificates
fix.evidence: gov.uk has no CAA record, so any certificate authority may issue for it.
fix.fix: Add a CAA record for the authority you use, for example 0 issue "letsencrypt.org".

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 110 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
